design_notes.purpose: Causal factorial follow-up to the canonical resource-pressure screen; it does not replace the completed continuous Latin-hypercube screen.
design_notes.mode: mixed plant-AMF association with uniform initial solution P
design_notes.regime_definition: Plant P- or C-limited when that resource limits more than half of realised-growth timesteps; no-growth timesteps are excluded.
design_notes.threshold_rule: Use the first adjacent observed initial-P pair that brackets a plant P-limited fraction of 0.5 and linearly interpolate only inside that pair. Record lower or upper censoring when no crossing is observed; never extrapolate.
design_notes.accounting: Retain condition checkpoints, limitation traces, and per-agent resource accounting. The combined result bundle is disabled because it is reconstructable from the checkpoints.
